name: Fort Praetorium
player_description: The praetorium is larger than it needs to be. A proper Roman house has been built inside the fort: atrium, triclinium, private baths. Corvinus lives here. You have not been inside.
gm_notes: Restricted access. DC 15 Persuasion to get a private audience with Corvinus. DC 17 Stealth to enter without an invitation. Inside: his private papers are in a locked chest (DC 14 Thieves' Tools). The papers reference 'the arrangement' and 'the senator's patience' without naming either. A DC 15 History check identifies the handwriting style as that of a professional courier, not Corvinus.
